papers.title_en: REWEAVE: Online Learning for Workload-Adaptive HNSW Indexes
papers.authors: Minghao Li, Nick Koudas, Raghav Mittal
papers.evidence: 面向工作负载自适应的HNSW近邻图在线重连
papers.tldr: HNSW图仅由数据构建，面对偏斜或变化的查询负载容易失配。REWEAVE利用查询反馈学习边效用，并在原节点度数上限内周期性重连底层图，兼容稀疏精确邻居反馈与自标签。静态偏斜下held-out召回最高提升23.3个百分点；在1亿向量上吞吐达NGFix的3.3倍，查询漂移流中recall@100从0.745升至0.979且距离计算少34%。它提供了图预算内的在线自适应索引维护方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vector databases rely on Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) indexes for similarity search, but a graph built from data alone can be poorly matched to a skewed or changing query workload. We present REWEAVE (Reward-Guided Rewiring of Vector Graphs), an online index-maintenance method that learns edge utility from query feedback and periodically rewires the bottom layer within the original per-node degree cap. The method supports sparse exact-neighbor feedback combined with self-labels, and standard HNSW serving without learning overhead once adaptation is disabled.   Under explicit assumptions we prove value-estimation and graph-stabilization guarantees. Under stationary skew, REWEAVE improves held-out recall by up to 23.3 percentage points over HNSW. In comparisons with query-aware baselines on up to 100M vectors, it achieves up to 3.3x NGFix's query throughput at recall@100 of 0.80. On Amazon-ESCI with query drift, it increases stream recall@100 from 0.745 to 0.979 with 34% fewer search distance computations than frozen HNSW. These results illustrate the potential to improve retrieval quality and reduce search effort within an existing graph-degree budget, while incurring additional work during adaptation.

papers.title_en: Can LLM Agents Organize Their Own Memory?
papers.authors: Zichuan Fu, Junjia Qi, Wenlin Zhang, Yimin Deng, Shirong Wang, Jinyang Li, Xian Wu, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的自组织外部记忆
papers.tldr: LLM智能体部署后权重固定，新信息只能存外部记忆，但现有方法依赖预定义记录和固定组织规则，难以适应任务演化。本文提出自组织记忆SoMem，用链接文档存储记忆，由智能体自主决定摘要内容、分组方式和修订时机，并保留原始交互作为证据。在LoCoMo、BEAM-100K、LongMemEval-S上分别比最强基线高2.66、3.10、2.00个百分点，且记忆可跨模型复用。结果表明智能体可通过普通文档组织并使用持久记忆。
papers.abstract_en: In most LLM agents, weights are fixed after deployment, so new information must be retained in external memory. Existing approaches often rely on predefined records and fixed organizational rules, which cannot readily accommodate evolving tasks and interactions. This raises the question: can LLM agents organize their own memory using ordinary documents? We introduce self-organized memory (SoMem), a framework that stores memory in linked documents. The agent decides what to summarize, how to group related information, and when to revise existing topics, and every summary it produces stays linked to the original interactions as evidence. The runtime validates updates and automatically derives temporal, relational, and recent-memory views from the organized content. At query time, the agent chooses what to search and read, following document links and inspecting original evidence as needed. On LoCoMo, BEAM-100K, and LongMemEval-S, SoMem outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.66, 3.10, and 2.00 percentage points, respectively. The constructed memory can be reused across models, and additional reasoning effort can further improve answer quality. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of agents organizing and using their own persistent memory through ordinary documents. Code is available at: https://github.com/Qi202/SoMem.

papers.title_en: Calibrated Early Termination with Bounded Optimality Gaps for Constrained Vector Search
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhang, Jingze Li, Baihua Zheng, Weiwei Sun
papers.evidence: 面向图索引最佳优先k近邻向量搜索的提前终止
papers.tldr: 面向带类别配额的向量检索，图索引的提前终止直接决定查询开销与结果是否精确。本文把风险约束下的停止规则建模为序多面体上的线性规划，用动态规划精确求出嵌套阶梯规则链，并以固定序列二项检验校准出 CaST。在百万级数据上，CaST 的开销不超过规则类最优的 1.132 倍，且在同风险目标下快于其他校准规则。该工作首次给出规则类最优间隙的可证明下界。
papers.abstract_en: Vector search over learned embeddings is the retrieval layer of recommendation and retrieval-augmented generation, and many applications cap how many answer items one category may contribute. Graph indexes answer a query by best-first traversal, and where it stops determines its cost and whether its answer is exact. We study early termination for such constrained $k$-nearest-neighbor ($k$-NN) queries, with plain $k$-NN as a special case, and seek the cheapest stopping rule whose answer is exact with probability at least $1-\varepsilon$. Learned early-termination methods instead target average recall, which does not guarantee exact answers. Multiple testing can calibrate any parameterized stopping rule to our target, but it cannot tell how much a better rule with the same risk and observations would save. Answering this needs a lower bound on the optimum of a rule family too large to enumerate, valid for the query population. Our key idea is to declare the observations a rule may use and to consider every rule monotone in them. Risk-constrained stopping then becomes a linear program over an order polytope, whose Lagrangian minimizers form a nested chain of staircase rules computed exactly by dynamic programming. Fixed-sequence binomial tests along this chain calibrate our rule, CaST, whose failure probability is at most $\varepsilon$ with confidence $1-δ$. Lagrangian weak duality bounds the optimum of the declared class from below at all risk levels at once, without a union bound over the rules. On two datasets of one million items each, CaST replayed on logged searches costs at most 1.132 times the class optimum for risk levels from 0.03 to 0.10, at 95% joint confidence per setting. Larger savings thus need a rule outside the class. At a common risk target on held-out queries, CaST is faster than every other calibrated rule we time, which take 4.8% to 45.5% more mean time.

papers.title_en: HyperPage: Learned Page Layouts for Disk-Resident Graph Vector Indexes
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhang, Jingze Li, Baihua Zheng, Weiwei Sun
papers.evidence: 面向磁盘图向量索引的学习式页布局
papers.tldr: 磁盘图向量索引按页读取记录，页布局决定搜索读页数。HyperPage利用搜索智能体运行日志重放遍历，在给定内存预算下学习记录分页，并联合选择热记录与页缓存划分。在1M和21M语料、七种缓存预算下，它比MARGO少读5.2%–21.2%页，缓存越小优势越大。该工作表明日志可把布局优化转化为可验证的重放问题，为SSD索引降低读放大。
papers.abstract_en: Disk-resident graph indexes such as DiskANN store each vector with its graph edges as one record on SSD pages. A search needs the page of every record it expands, so its page reads depend on the page layout, that is, which records share a page. Search agents trained with reinforcement learning query one such index run after run, and every graph traversal can be logged with the records it expands. We therefore use the logs of a finished run to lay out the index for a declared memory budget, so later runs read fewer pages. In contrast, existing layouts such as Starling and MARGO are computed from the graph and vectors and use no logs. Learning a layout from logs is challenging, because the logs must stay valid under every layout, the saving depends on what the budget caches, and the best layout is NP-hard to find. Our key observation is that DiskANN-style search routes on in-memory codes and the records it expands, never on their page-mates. As a result, the logged traversals price every layout by replay, and cached records add no page reads. Accordingly, we propose HyperPage, which first builds layouts for the declared budget on the logged traversals of uncached records. It then selects one layout, together with the budget split between hot records and a page cache, by replaying validation steps. In addition, a Lagrangian lower bound shows how far a layout may be from the optimum. We learn from one Search-R1 agent run and test on a later run with a different reward, over 1M and 21M passages. Across seven cache budgets, HyperPage reads 5.2% to 21.2% fewer pages than MARGO, and no compared layout reads fewer. The advantage is largest when the cache is small. For example, at 1% of the 1M index, MARGO needs nearly 3 times the budget to read as few pages. On the 21M index, HyperPage also cuts search time per step by up to 10.4%. The saving holds for a second agent model and a second corpus.

papers.title_en: AstroMemBench: A Benchmark for Memory Systems in Embodied Spacecraft Agents
papers.authors: You Wu, Guhong Zhang, Hongwei Li, Xinyue Hong, Yuan Jia
papers.evidence: 面向自主智能体记忆系统的评测基准
papers.tldr: 针对航天器具身智能体在通信延迟、资源受限与安全约束下的长期自主需求，提出记忆基准 AstroMemBench，并用场景-挑战-能力设计法将需求转为可执行测试。基准含九项任务、16类子挑战、140个模板和2240个实例，按任务完成、状态变化、安全与资源确定性评分。六种配置中 Mem0、Chain-of-Memory、LightMem 与 RAG 均优于原生 Pi Agent，但三者较 RAG 无明显优势；重启后 Mem0 高12.25分。该工作为航天记忆系统设计、开发与选型提供公开评测支撑。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term spacecraft autonomy requires embodied agents to use operational history under communication delays, time-critical operations, environmental uncertainty, complex physical interactions, power and computational constraints, and safety and reliability requirements. We introduce AstroMemBench and a Scenario-Challenge-Capability design method that maps these requirements to executable memory tests. The benchmark covers 16 memory subchallenges through 140 templates and 2240 instances across nine tasks in planetary surface operations, on-orbit servicing, and deep-space exploration. A deterministic environment scores actions for task completion, state changes, safety, and resource use. Ablations under nine conditions show that the benchmark is sensitive to how accurately agents recover and use historical information and to differences in memory-system design. Main experiments compare six configurations. Mem0, Chain-of-Memory, LightMem, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improve same-session mean scores over native Pi Agent, with no clear advantage of the three memory systems over RAG. After a session restart, Mem0 outperforms RAG by 12.25 points. Benefits favor instruction retention and result reuse over ongoing state tracking and energy reservation. AstroMemBench supports the design, development, and selection of memory systems for embodied spacecraft agents. AstroMemBench 1.0 and its evaluation code are publicly available: https://github.com/flyingView/AstroMemBench-v1.

papers.title_en: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Zheng Jiang, Fang Niu, Bo Peng, Houde Qian, Wenyi Li, Deyao Hong, Mingju Gao, Yizhe Chi, Youjie Zheng, Kaisen Yang, Calvin Xiao, Lifeng Sun, Huan-ang Gao
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体工作流编排能力的评测基准
papers.tldr: LLM智能体正从单模型走向多智能体系统，模型可在运行时创建工作者并编写可执行工作流，这种组织能力缺乏专门评测。WorkflowArena构建145个长周期任务，覆盖8个专业领域，任务含初始工作区与隐藏验证器评估的集成交付物，并记录所有委派。九模型实验显示不同模型委派策略各异，且Claude Opus 5.5编写的工作流能提升较弱执行者，表明工作流组织本身是可测量的性能决定因素。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.

papers.title_en: Activation-Guided Graph Retrieval for Cognitive Memory Reconstruction in Language Model Systems
papers.authors: Marvin Danig
papers.evidence: 基于记忆图的检索增强语言模型上下文选择
papers.tldr: 现有检索增强语言模型多按查询相关性选取上下文，难以支持长期AI系统对记忆可用性的需求。作者提出激活条件化记忆架构：请求与目标线索激活授权记忆图，激活与扇出衰减分配有界遍历前沿，实体递归发出线索，并在生成前重建类型化证据图。文中给出五项架构推论、实现级成本估计、消融与失败条件及可复现评测协议，未报告基准测量。其贡献是把检索从排序列表推进到可解释证据路径，并设定可证伪条件。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented language model systems generally select context by query-conditioned relevance. We argue that long-lived AI systems require a second operator: activation-conditioned memory availability. We specify an architecture in which request and goal cues seed an authorized memory graph, activation and fan attenuation allocate a bounded traversal frontier, retrieved entities recursively emit cues, and a typed evidence graph is reconstructed before generation. The specification yields five architectural consequences about candidate selection, traversal control, graph regularization, evidence reconstruction, and reinforcement. We derive implementation-level cost estimates and define ablations, failure conditions, and a reproducible evaluation protocol. The central claim is narrowed or falsified if a simpler graph reranker matches full traversal on causal and temporal recovery under equal budgets. This architecture-and-analysis preprint reports no benchmark measurements. If the claim holds, retrieval returns the evidence path that makes a memory available, not only a ranked list.

papers.title_en: BioMem: Agentic Memory for Biomedical LLM Agents
papers.authors: Mingchen Li, Yongkang Xiao, Rumeng Li, Rui Zhang, Hong Yu
papers.evidence: 评估智能体记忆的保留、检索与长期鲁棒性
papers.tldr: 生物医学LLM智能体记忆在保留、检索、更新与利用信息上的效果尚缺乏系统评估。本文在知识推理、临床预测和长期对话三类场景中，评测5种记忆方法与4个LLM，并提出免训练框架HMRU。HMRU联合增强证据可访问性与任务感知利用，平均相对提升8.6%，对话错误降低24.9%。该工作系统刻画生物医学智能体记忆，并提供可靠改进方案。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable potential in biomedical applications, while agentic memory systems have emerged as a promising approach to preserving and utilizing information across tasks and interactions. However, a fundamental question remains: how effectively and reliably do these systems retain, retrieve, update, and utilize biomedical information? In this study, we systematically investigate agentic memory in the biomedical domain, focusing on task effectiveness, retrieval quality, information fidelity, and long-term robustness. We evaluate five memory approaches across four LLMs in three representative settings: biomedical knowledge reasoning, clinical prediction, and long-term conversational memory. Our analyses reveal how memory construction, evidence relevance, and conversational history shape downstream biomedical performance, highlighting the distinct challenges of retrieving relevant information, preserving its fidelity, and effectively utilizing it for reasoning. Building on these findings, we introduce Hybrid Memory Retrieval and Utilization (HMRU), a training-free framework that jointly enhances evidence accessibility and task-aware utilization to improve biomedical reasoning and long-term conversational memory. HMRU achieves an average relative improvement of 8.6% across biomedical question-answering and conversational memory benchmarks, with additional gains in selected clinical prediction tasks. It further reduces conversational answer errors by 24.9% and closes 48.0% of the performance gap to full-context inference. Our findings provide a systematic characterization of biomedical agentic memory and practical insights into developing more effective and reliable memory-augmented LLM systems.

papers.title_en: VecDBLens: An Evaluatology-Based Framework for Vector Database Diagnosis
papers.authors: Yutong Zhou, Guoxin Kang, Wenxin Zhou, Haoyu He, Yuedong Zhu, Lei Wang, Wanling Gao, Fanda Fan, Jianfeng Zhan
papers.evidence: 诊断向量数据库精度、吞吐与成本的评测框架
papers.tldr: 现有向量数据库评测多聚焦索引，把嵌入视为固定输入、忽略查询时执行，难以判断瓶颈应归于嵌入模型、索引还是查询处理。VecDBLens 基于 Evaluatology 把待诊断功能作为被评对象、其余因素作为匹配评测条件，通过匹配条件下对比与 ANOVA 归因性能差异。结果显示检索性能受嵌入质量根本性上界约束，更强索引参数化并不总有益，可能重塑邻域拓扑致召回回退。该框架将排行榜式基准测试转为可复现诊断流程，为定位真实性能驱动因素提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Vector databases are increasingly deployed as retrieval pipelines in which representation, indexing, and query-time execution jointly determine accuracy, throughput, and cost. Existing vector database evaluations primarily focus on indexing while treating embeddings as fixed inputs and ignoring the role of query-time execution, making it difficult to decide whether a bottleneck should be addressed by changing the embedding model, the index, or the query-processing functions. To address the above limitation, we introduce VecDBLens, an Evaluatology-based framework that treats the function under diagnosis as an evaluated object and all remaining dataset, workload, parameter, and runtime factors as matched evaluation conditions. VecDBLens attributes performance differences to individual evaluated objects through comparisons under matched evaluation conditions, summarizing their performance and stability across multiple datasets and workloads. It further analyzes interactions among objects using analysis of variance (ANOVA), thereby turning vector database benchmarking from leaderboard ranking into a reproducible diagnostic procedure. VecDBLens reveals two key insights. First, retrieval performance is fundamentally upper-bounded by embedding quality, revealing that many apparent indexing failures are therefore representation-side limitations. Second, stronger index parameterization is not always beneficial: overly aggressive configurations can reshape neighborhood topology and cause recall regression. These results challenge the common practice of evaluating vector databases primarily through indexing and show that real-world limitations arise from constraints across retrieval functions rather than any single function alone. VecDBLens provides a principled basis for identifying the true performance drivers of vector databases and for guiding their design in practical applications.

papers.title_en: DISCERN: Preserve at Write, Resolve at Read for Persistent LLM-Agent Memory
papers.authors: Chirag Ahuja, Vladislav Tanov, Ramcharan Kakarla, Jonathan Taws
papers.evidence: 面向LLM智能体的长期持久记忆与嵌入检索
papers.tldr: 企业智能体跨多会话累积记忆，事实相互矛盾、被新值取代、同名实体在嵌入空间混淆，现有系统将其视为检索问题。DISCERN提出“写入时保留、读取时解析”原则：写入端构建严格增量的双时态溯源图，不合并易混实体、不丢弃被取代值；读取端用零LLM工具接口驱动智能体循环导航该图。在ENT-310上弃答F1达0.924，宏平均答案正确率0.861，均领先基线。
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agents accumulate memory across dozens of sessions in which facts contradict, get superseded, and blur as similarly named entities collide in embedding space. The field treats this as a retrieval problem; we show it is not. On ENT-310, a synthetic enterprise sales-agent memory benchmark of 310 queries (210 answerable, 100 unanswerable), a vanilla Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reader over a memory store already matches strong memory systems on the recall pillars. Retention and currency are near-saturated, roughly 0.93 to 0.98 for every competent system, so recall is essentially solved. What remains unsolved is resolution: which entity a query refers to, which time-state is current, and whether to commit an answer at all or decline when evidence is insufficient. We propose DISCERN (DISambiguation and Cross-session Episodic memoRy Navigation), an agent-memory framework built on a single rule: preserve at write, resolve at read. At write time DISCERN builds a strictly additive bi-temporal provenance graph that never merges confusable entities and never drops superseded values. At read time a zero-LLM tool surface drives an agentic loop that navigates this graph and commits exactly one of four gated terminal actions. A four-judge LLM-as-a-Judge council scores two axes: answer correctness on answerable questions, and the answer-versus-abstain decision as a classification problem. On ENT-310, DISCERN is the best-calibrated system on abstention (F1 0.924 versus at most 0.802 across eight baselines) and leads macro answer correctness under equal pillar weighting (0.861 versus 0.806 for the strongest baseline), a lead driven by entity resolution (0.800, where no baseline exceeds 0.40). Applied with zero tuning to the full LoCoMo corpus, the same pipeline again leads macro answer correctness (0.663 versus 0.638) and stays among the best-calibrated on false-premise abstention.

papers.title_en: Authenticated Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search in Outsourced Vector Databases
papers.authors: Yuanhang Zhou, Xinyi Zhang, Cheng Xu, Jianliang Xu
papers.evidence: 外包向量数据库中的可认证近似最近邻搜索
papers.tldr: 外包向量数据库中的近似最近邻搜索面临不可信云返回伪造或次优结果的问题，现有认证方案因传输高维向量和拓扑无关证明而开销巨大。VIDA以紧凑向量承诺替代原始向量传输，并用聚合内积论证批量验证距离计算；同时提出拓扑感知认证结构MeST和量化感知剪枝策略，减少结构证明与精确距离认证数量。实验显示端到端延迟最高加速6.6倍，数据传输时间最多降低99.2%。该工作显著提升认证ANN搜索的可扩展性与实用性。
papers.abstract_en: Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search has become a fundamental query primitive in modern vector databases for managing large-scale embedding data. To support growing vector collections, organizations increasingly outsource database management and query processing to third-party clouds. However, untrusted service providers may return suboptimal or fabricated results, posing a serious threat to ANN search integrity. Existing authenticated ANN approaches face substantial scalability challenges. They typically require transmitting high-dimensional vectors for distance verification and rely on topology-agnostic authentication structures, resulting in excessive communication and verification overhead. In this paper, we propose VIDA, a novel and efficient scheme for authenticated graph-based ANN search. VIDA replaces raw vector transmission with compact vector commitments and employs an aggregated Inner Product Argument to efficiently verify multiple distance computations. Furthermore, we introduce MeST, a topology-aware authenticated data structure that aligns authentication paths with graph traversal, significantly reducing structural proof overhead. Additionally, we design a quantization-aware authentication strategy that exploits distance bounds for pruning, reducing the number of exact distances requiring cryptographic authentication. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed schemes substantially improve the efficiency of authenticated ANN search, achieving up to a $6.6\times$ speedup in end-to-end latency and reducing data transfer time by up to 99.2% compared with state-of-the-art methods.

papers.title_en: Singularity-Bench: Can Agents Build Agents?
papers.authors: Yang Zhou, Krish Agarwal, Zhuoming Chen, Zerui Wang, Zhenyu Zhang, Wenshuang Li, Xinpeng Wei, Zhichen Zeng, Jingyu Liu, Jue Wang, Sen Wu, Ziheng Jiang, Zhen Dong, Han Cai, Binhang Yuan, Ying Sheng, Ce Zhang, Bo Li, Beidi Chen
papers.evidence: 面向自主智能体端到端任务的开放式基准
papers.tldr: 现有基准常限制智能体动作空间、简化环境且验证不可靠，难以评估其自主开发AI系统的能力。为此提出开放式基准Singularity-Bench，设六项端到端任务，覆盖预训练、中期训练、后训练、推理、智能体框架与集群编排，要求从最小起点构建核心系统，并在相同硬件上与人类工程基线对比。作者还通过红队测试揭示奖励黑客漏洞，并提出Breakwater扩展加以封堵。在11个智能体中，Opus 5.5配Claude Code六项任务均达到或超过人类基线，Singularity-Index为1.25，其余智能体平均仅0.58，显示前沿智能体已具备较高AI开发自动化潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI agents increasingly succeed on realistic, long-horizon tasks and are beginning to improve the systems through which they operate. Yet existing benchmarks often restrict agents to narrow action spaces, use simplified environments, or rely on verification methods that are unreliable for evaluating arbitrary agent-generated systems. We introduce Singularity-Bench, an open-ended benchmark for autonomous AI development with six end-to-end tasks spanning pre-training, mid-training, post-training, inference, the agent harness, and cluster orchestration. Each task requires agents to implement core systems from a minimal starting point and evaluates them against mature human-engineered baselines on identical hardware. Additionally, through extensive red-teaming covering 9 of the 10 categories in the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, we expose reward-hacking vulnerabilities in the conventional Harbor framework and develop Breakwater, an extension of Harbor that blocks all attacks tested in our study. Across 11 agents built from 7 frontier models and 2 harnesses, Opus 5.5 with Claude Code matches or outperforms the human baseline on all six tasks with a Singularity-Index of 1.25, suggesting it may have the skills needed to reach the singularity. The remaining agents average only 0.58. Our vision is for Singularity-Bench to track how much of AI development agents can already automate and when they may transition from assisting to taking end-to-end responsibility for building stronger successors.

papers.title_en: AnalogLayoutWorld: An Open Benchmark for Agentic Analog Layout Design
papers.authors: NovaSilicon Team
papers.evidence: 含40个专家评审任务的开源智能体评测基准
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体在受物理约束的长期工程任务上能力仍不清楚，本文以模拟电路版图设计为切入点。作者提出开源基准 AnalogLayoutWorld，含40个专家评审任务、集成设计环境、独立物理与后布局电学验证及客观质量指标。在13种模型-工具配置中，91.1%能生成GDS版图，但仅23.0%通过验收标准。内部智能体Novara综合得分最高，研究还表明固定预算下的推理效率与验证反馈利用影响复杂任务表现。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software development, yet their ability to tackle long-horizon engineering tasks governed by physical constraints remains less understood. We study this question through analog circuit layout, which demands domain knowledge, geometric reasoning, and iterative interaction with design and verification tools. We introduce \textbf{AnalogLayoutWorld}, an open-source agent benchmark with 40 expert-reviewed tasks for end-to-end layout generation from fixed transistor-level netlists. It combines an integrated design environment with independent physical and post-layout electrical verification, as well as objective layout quality metrics co-designed with analog layout experts. Across 13 model--harness configurations, 91.1\% of attempts produce GDS layouts, but only 23.0\% satisfy the benchmark's acceptance criteria. We also evaluate Novara, an internally developed agent system, which achieves the highest reported aggregate score. Our analysis links performance differences to test-time scaling under fixed budgets, suggesting that reasoning efficiency and effective use of verification feedback help sustain design quality as task complexity grows.

papers.title_en: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
papers.authors: Jingdong Zhang, Jionghao Wang, Zhengming Yu, Yancheng Cai, Wei Chow, Chris Choy, Zhiyang Dou, Hang Hua, Jiachen Li, Zhixuan Liu, Chen Wang, Songlin Wei, Siyuan Yang, Yu Yuan, Xiaohang Zhan, Yucheng Zhang, Shuhong Zheng, Xin Li, Lingjie Liu, Wojciech Matusik, Zhengzhong Tu, Wenping Wang
papers.evidence: 评估前沿智能体递归自我改进的基准
papers.tldr: 前沿模型作为智能体部署时，表现还取决于提示、工具、记忆与控制回路构成的 harness。现有基准多固定 harness 只评答案，Flex-RSI 在固定预算下让 executor 改进任务解、经留出验证筛选后，再由 improver 递归修订 harness 及自身。它覆盖感知、推理、机器人动作、三维重建、视觉创作与基础设施，并用隐藏测试评分。结果显示：智能体自建方案时自改进收益最大，仅记录成败会限制开源模型，物理稳定性或精确正确性严格校验处差距最大，且编辑 harness 本身确有贡献。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier language models are increasingly deployed as agents, and how well an agent performs depends not only on its model but also on its harness: the prompts, tools, memory, and control loop through which the model acts. When an agent is applied to a new problem, a natural question is whether it can use the feedback of the task to improve the way it works, and not merely its answer. Most existing benchmarks keep the agent's harness fixed and score the solution it produces, or target large-scale model training. We introduce Flex-RSI, a benchmark for the recursive self-improvement of agents on vision and robotics tasks under a fixed budget. In each round, an executor improves the task solution, which is kept only if it scores higher on held-out validation data, and an improver then revises the harness, including the executor and itself. Every run starts from the same general-purpose harness, and the final solution is scored on hidden test data. Evaluating closed-source and open-weight models on tasks spanning perception, reasoning, robot action, 3D reconstruction, visual creation, and infrastructure, we find that self-improvement helps most when the agent builds its own solution, that feedback recording only success or failure holds back open-weight models, and that open-weight models fall furthest behind where outputs must pass strict checks of physical stability or exact correctness. Paired runs further show that editing the harness itself contributes to the gains.

papers.title_en: Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving
papers.authors: Gabriel Souza Baggio, Gabriel Machado Lunardi, Guilherme Medeiros Machado, Subhankar Maity, Faiza Belbachir, José Palazzo Moreira de Oliveira
papers.evidence: 结合嵌入检索与相似度搜索的检索增强生成
papers.tldr: 针对竞赛编程问题对LLM代码生成与算法推理的双重挑战，本文提出一种基于相似问题检索的RAG方法，通过嵌入检索、相似度搜索与动态阈值筛选知识库样例。在CodeContests上比较原始描述、随机样例与检索样例三种设置，并以通过率和CodeForces Elo评估。结果显示相似检索显著提升模型表现，且Min-K分析辅助区分检索泛化与训练记忆。该工作为算法解题中的代码生成提供了可扩展的增强框架。
papers.abstract_en: Competitive programming problems pose distinctive challenges for Large Language Models, as they demand not only proficient code generation but also advanced algorithmic reasoning. This study presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach specifically designed to enhance the capacity of Large Language Models to address such problems. Our approach integrates an embedding-based retrieval mechanism and a similarity search algorithm to identify analogous problems within a knowledge database, employing a dynamically adjusted threshold to mitigate retrieval noise. We conducted an evaluation using the CodeContests dataset, focusing on the test split problems that exhibit similarity to instances from the training split. The experimental framework considered three conditions: (i) problems provided solely with their original descriptions, (ii) problems supplemented with randomly selected examples from the training split, and (iii) problems augmented with similar examples retrieved through the proposed method. In addition, we incorporated a Min-K membership inference analysis to examine whether the generated code solutions were influenced by potential memorization of training data within the evaluated Large Language Models. This complementary perspective enables a deeper understanding of model behavior by distinguishing genuine generalization through retrieval from implicit recall of pretraining samples. Performance was assessed using both pass rates and the CodeForces Elo rating of the problems. The results provide empirical evidence that similarity-based retrieval substantially enhances Large Language Models performance in competitive programming scenarios, offering an scalable framework for improving code generation in algorithmic problem-solving contexts.

papers.title_en: PatternBloom: Empowering Agentic RAG with Externalized RL-Distilled Graph Patterns
papers.authors: Yi Ge, Heng Huang
papers.evidence: 智能体式检索增强生成框架
papers.tldr: 现有Agentic RAG以内容为检索单元，把程序性推理压在隐状态中，随推理深度增加易饱和。PatternBloom将检索单元转向逻辑：先用信息密度奖励筛选高信息增益证据图，蒸馏出图模式记忆，再用模式增强奖励对齐策略。7B模型在27个基线上平均OOD EM提升15.0，且增益随推理深度累积。该工作把可复用推理骨架外化为结构先验，为深度RAG提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning-trained agents for retrieval-augmented generation retrieve content (passages, knowledge-graph fragments, or hyperedges) and supervise training with outcome rewards on the final answer. Across these paradigms the reasoning route through retrieved content never leaves the language model's hidden state, conflating declarative knowledge with the procedural knowledge that recurs across queries of the same logical type; content-only methods consequently plateau as reasoning depth grows. We introduce PatternBloom, an agentic RAG framework that shifts the unit of retrieval from content (what to read) to logic (how to reason). A first RL stage scores the agent's constructed evidence graph by a frozen oracle's information gain through the Information-Density Reward (IDR), a size-normalized mutual-information surrogate. High-reward trajectories are distilled into a Graph Pattern Memory (GPM) of type-abstracted reasoning skeletons, and a second RL stage uses the Pattern-Augmented Reward (PAR) to couple policy to memory, turning procedural reasoning into a learnable, externalized structural prior. A 7B PatternBloom outperforms $27$ baselines by $+15.0$ Avg-OOD EM, with the gain compounding with reasoning depth precisely because procedural knowledge, once distilled, is reused rather than re-derived at every query. We release our code at https://github.com/EllenYiGe/PatternBloom.

papers.title_en: MMGraph-Agent: Agentic Multimodal RAG via Cache-Inspired Multimodal Knowledge HyperGraphs
papers.authors: Haoran Luo, Ziyue Zhu, Shangyang Wu, Linhao Luo, Yikai Guo, Qika Lin, Fangzhi Xu, Jiapu Wang, Xiaobao Wu, Yifan Zhu, Luu Anh Tuan
papers.evidence: 统一多模态RAG框架，采用动态记忆式检索缓解长上下文问题
papers.tldr: 多模态RAG需兼顾知识组织与检索增强，但现有方法构建成本高、受上下文窗口限制，且离线与在线知识源难以统一训练。MMGraph-Agent以缓存启发的多模态知识超图为核心，实现零API成本的轻量超图构建与动态记忆检索。离线、在线及联合检索实验显示其在性能、效率和架构统一性上均稳定提升。该工作为统一多模态RAG提供了低成本、可扩展的新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Driven by increasingly complex real-world applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has evolved from textual pipelines to multimodal settings, comprising two complementary dimensions: knowledge organization and retrieval enhancement. However, existing methods still face challenges of high construction cost, context window limitations, and the lack of unified training across offline and online knowledge sources. To address these challenges, we propose MMGraph-Agent, a unified multimodal RAG framework based on cache-inspired multimodal knowledge hypergraphs. MMGraph-Agent enables extremely lightweight hypergraph construction with zero API cost and dynamic memory-based retrieval that alleviates long-context issues. Experiments across offline, online, and joint retrieval settings demonstrate consistent improvements in performance, efficiency, and architectural unification. Our software and data are publicly available at https://github.com/LHRLAB/MMGraph-Agent.

papers.title_en: CORE: Coarse-to-Fine Search with Context Management for Deep Research
papers.authors: Hoang Tran Vuong, Ngoc Quan Pham, Hung Bui, Fatih Porikli, Dat Quoc Nguyen
papers.evidence: 面向研究智能体的稠密检索与上下文管理
papers.tldr: 深度研究智能体需反复搜索，但长段落利于语义匹配、返回证据又占上下文，形成权衡。CORE作为免训练harness，用稠密检索取段落，借late-interaction重排的token相似度抽取最相关片段，并管理上下文支持扩展与去重。在三个模型、三个基准和最多553M文档语料上，相较Tongyi DeepResearch与OpenResearcher取得更优答案准确率和证据召回。该工作为深度研究检索提供粗到细搜索与上下文管理方案。
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents answer complex questions through repeated search. They rely on a harness that runs their tool calls and returns evidence to their context. This creates a trade-off: Search works best over long passages, which give enough context for reliable semantic matching. But the returned evidence should be short, because every observation stays in the agent's context for the rest of the trajectory. We introduce CORE, a training-free harness that combines coarse-to-fine search with context management. CORE retrieves passages with a dense retriever. It then reuses the token-level similarities from a late-interaction reranker to return only the most relevant snippet from each passage. Context management lets the agent expand the context around sources it has already retrieved and suppresses repeated snippets. In controlled closed-search comparisons with the Tongyi DeepResearch and OpenResearcher harnesses, CORE achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and evidence recall across three agent models and three benchmarks (BrowseComp-Plus, BrowseComp-Wikipedia and BrowseComp-Plus-CM), on corpora containing up to 553M documents.

papers.title_en: MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
papers.authors: David H. Yang, Blake Bullwinkel, Amanda Minnich, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri, Giorgio Severi
papers.evidence: 追踪LLM智能体记忆投毒的基准
papers.tldr: LLM智能体借助记忆提升长程多会话任务表现，但记忆也引入可被跨会话传播的投毒攻击面。作者提出MemoryDojo基准，用155条多领域多会话轨迹追踪毒化信息的生命周期，并覆盖五类记忆系统。评估显示所有记忆系统均可被投毒，下游影响差异显著；进一步提出记忆感知的投毒优化提升攻击效果。该工作为理解与缓解智能体记忆风险提供统一评测平台。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents benefit from using memory systems to improve performance on long-horizon, multi-session tasks. However, memory introduces a critical attack surface. Malicious instructions encountered in one session may be stored and propagated through memory before being retrieved and acted upon in later sessions. Because memory systems differ in how they process and retrieve information, the downstream effects of poisoning can vary significantly across systems. To quantify the effects of poisoning across different memory architectures, we introduce MemoryDojo, a benchmark for tracing the lifecycle of poisoned information through agent memory and measuring its influence on subsequent agent behavior. MemoryDojo is easily extensible, consists of 155 multi-session long-horizon trajectories covering four domains, and supports five different memory systems. Through our evaluation, we find that all memory systems are susceptible to memory poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects. We further propose a memory-aware poison optimization process that increases the poisoning efficacy, highlighting differences between memory architectures. We hope that MemoryDojo will support research on understanding and mitigating agentic memory risks.

papers.title_en: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
papers.authors: Yunzhe Wang, Mesut Erhan Unal, Sheng Zhang, Shabnam Ghadar, Peng Tang
papers.evidence: 面向智能体的多粒度记忆系统
papers.tldr: 自演化智能体可从经验中提炼技能与记忆，但跨用户、异构智能体共享经验时，必须判断每条经验对谁有益、哪些信息必须保密。MixUA 将独立用户—智能体轨迹蒸馏为经验，并按受益对象与披露风险把经验分配到用户—智能体对、用户、智能体或全局四种范围。在含五用户、七智能体的 CrossLearnBench 上，通过率最高提升 16 点，并保留 90% 偏好，隐私探针命中率不超过 0.02%。
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. We present MixUA, a memory system that distills independent user-agent trajectories into lessons and assigns each lesson to a user-agent pair, user, agent, or global scope according to whom it benefits and what it may disclose. For evaluation, we introduce CrossLearnBench, a mixed-user-agent benchmark that pairs established agent tasks with user preferences and privacy probes that test whether private facts leak into memory other users can read. With five users and seven agents, MixUA raises pass rates by up to 16 points over no memory and 5 over a single global memory, even on tasks previously tried only by other users on other agents. It retains up to 90% of previously stated preferences, and at most 0.02% of privacy probes find a planted private fact in a forbidden scope. We hope MixUA offers a scalable path toward a global system where users and agents co-evolve.

papers.title_en: CAROUSEL: GPU-Accelerated Private Vector Search via Homomorphic Sketching
papers.authors: Sohaib, Divyakant Agrawal, Amr El Abbadi, Soamar Homsi
papers.evidence: GPU加速的隐私向量检索，在加密域对全语料打分
papers.tldr: 在不可信服务器上做向量检索会泄露查询嵌入，现有全同态加密方案仍需全扫描并对密文分数排序，难以扩展。Carousel 在加密域为全库向量打分，利用幂次抑制保留少量大分数，仅靠同态加法把稀疏结果压缩为对数级密文，交客户端排序。它在十亿级 BIGANN SIFT1B 上取得 recall@100 0.9715，单 GPU 亿级查询延迟 3.735 秒，且无候选丢弃召回损失、增删即时生效。
papers.abstract_en: Vector search on untrusted infrastructure exposes the \emph{query embedding}, a faithful summary of the user's intent. Fully homomorphic encryption can hide the query, but existing approaches still require a full scan followed by ranking of encrypted scores. Scalable private systems avoid encrypted ranking by either sending scores from a single cluster to the client or moving the search to the client, which must first stream the entire vector index for preprocessing. We present \textsc{Carousel}, which instead scores the full corpus under encryption and compresses the results for client-side ranking. The server scores every vector under encryption, raises the scores to a power that preserves their order by magnitude while suppressing all but a handful, and compresses the resulting sparse vector into a logarithmic number of ciphertexts using homomorphic additions alone. Because every vector is scored, \textsc{Carousel} incurs no recall loss from discarding candidates. Since clients hold no database-dependent state, insertions and deletions take effect immediately at the cost of a single vector write. \textsc{Carousel} searches $1$ billion vectors of BIGANN SIFT1B across multiple GPUs and achieves recall@100 of $0.9715$. At $100$ million SIFT vectors, it achieves recall@100 of $0.9845$ with a query latency of $3.735$ seconds on a single GPU.
